title: Telegram adapter implementation
description: Implement the TelegramAdapter interface from src/telegram/index.ts: notify(text) as the single outbound path and onMessage(handler) as the single inbound path, over exactly one conversation (ADR-0003). Validate Pitgram first for silent shared-session background turns per docs/research/README.md; fall back to the smallest grammY bridge only via a new ADR. A test currently pins the module to zero runtime exports and must flip when this lands.
author: Tomislav Zorcec

comments.text: Implemented and landed as eef6e45 (pushed to main). Direct grammY Bot per ADR-0007: getMe-validated factory, explicit start() after handler attach, paired-chat-only inbound, fetch-seam error recording; entry auto-attaches when the env pair is present and degrades loudly otherwise; half-config fails with named codes; grammy ships bundled (noExternal). Tests: tests/grammy.test.ts (8 green), config telegram tests (3), entry wiring tests (3: inbound followUp, invalid-token degraded session, half-config refusal). Full pnpm check green (20 files, 173 passed + 5 todo); coverage thresholds green; artifact suite green. Lane fixes: microtask-starvation hang (stub yields to macrotask queue), error visibility via owned fetch seam, tsup external-to-bundled, ADR-0001/2/3/4/6 re-affirmations with 0003 Pitgram clause retired.
comments.author: agent
